name: Sund Manufacturing Co
old_description: We provide complete turn-key services with structural welding, pipe welding, pipe fitting, construction, and electrical all done on site.  Once the product is completed, we offer on-time delivery to the job site.
about:
Based in Newburg, North Dakota, Sund Manufacturing Co describes itself as a fourth-generation family-owned business with "80 years and still going strong." The company traces its roots to a family operation that has grown into a full-service fabrication and manufacturing provider for the oil field and industrial sectors.

The company provides turn-key fabrication services including structural welding (AWS D1.1 certified in FCAW and GMAW), pipe welding (certified to ASME Section IX, B31.3, and API 1104 in SMAW, GMAW, and GTAW), pipe fitting, construction of steel or wood insulated buildings, assembly with hydrostatic and pneumatic testing per B31.3, electrical wiring by master and journeyman electricians, and a 7,700-square-foot climate-controlled paint and blast facility with 36-by-22-by-18-foot booths staffed by a NACE CIP Level 1 inspector. Its quality program is based on ISO 9001 and includes certified weld inspectors, non-destructive testing, and factory acceptance testing. Lean manufacturing principles such as 5S, waste elimination, and level-loaded production have reportedly increased capacity by 66 percent while cutting waste 45 percent and costs 28 percent.

Sund Manufacturing primarily serves the oil and gas industry, supplying engineered equipment and structures built to withstand harsh North Dakota climates. Its customer base includes operators and contractors requiring custom or repeatable fabricated assemblies, insulated enclosures, and fully wired, plug-and-play modules for field deployment.

The company emphasizes its family-ownership heritage as a differentiator, stating that its reputation drives a commitment to exceed customer expectations. It also highlights its adoption of lean manufacturing and a comprehensive quality management system as reasons customers choose Sund for complex, high-reliability projects.

name: Sundance Power Systems Inc
old_description: Founded in 1995, Sundance Power Systems is deeply rooted in the region and understands the unique energy needs, terrain, and building styles of homes in the mountains and surrounding areas. Our team brings decades of combined experience and a strong commitment to quality craftsmanship, ensuring every system is designed and installed to perform at the highest level.
about:
Sundance Power Systems Inc was incorporated in May 1995 in Weaverville, North Carolina, to expand the environmental work of its founders and bring renewable energy to the broader community. The company negotiated the state’s first net metering agreement in 1996 and helped shape North Carolina’s interconnection policy through Senate Bill 3 in 1998. In 2007 it relocated to Weaverville, where it built a 4,100-square-foot shop and supply warehouse in 2014.

The firm designs, installs, and services renewable energy systems including grid-tied and off-grid solar photovoltaics, battery storage, radiant floor heating, solar hot water, micro hydro, and wind power. It also manufactures the VersaCor, a standardized hydronic heating system introduced in 2002. Sundance serves residential and commercial clients, with a portfolio exceeding 2,000 installations by 2018. Its service department maintains systems originally installed by other contractors and offers annual maintenance agreements.

Customers span homeowners, businesses, institutions, and government agencies. Notable projects include a 600 kW array for Sierra Nevada Brewing’s Mills River facility, solar hot water at Camp Lejeune and Cherry Point, photovoltaic and solar thermal installations at Catawba College, and systems for the Catholic Diocese of Charlotte. The company has provided mobile solar power for the Indigo Girls’ Earth Day concert and the Standing Rock protests, and partnered with Duke Energy on a statewide rebate program.

Sundance differentiates itself through a five-step design process led by Renewable Energy Consultants who avoid high-pressure sales, a service team that works on any brand of equipment, and membership in the Amicus Solar Cooperative for collective buying power. Its early policy work established net metering and renewable energy credit markets in North Carolina, positioning the company as a long-standing advocate for clean energy adoption in the Carolinas.

name: Sunforce Solar
old_description: Founded in 2020, we started with a vision to change the way people think about energy. From a small local startup to a leading provider of solar systems, we’ve grown by helping thousands of clients switch to renewable energy and save money.
about:
Sunforce Solar, based in Las Cruces, New Mexico, was founded in 2020 by Obed Dominguez. The company began as a local startup with a vision to change how people think about energy, growing into a regional provider of solar installation services across multiple states.

The company designs, installs, and maintains complete clean-energy systems for residential and commercial customers. Services include rooftop and ground-mount solar panel installation, home battery backup systems, Level 2 EV charger installation, solar panel maintenance, and re-roofing to prepare structures for solar. Sunforce handles permitting, interconnection applications, and final inspection across its service territory, which spans New Mexico, Texas, Colorado, Arkansas, and Pennsylvania. The company emphasizes a $0-down financing model that allows homeowners to replace utility payments with system ownership.

Sunforce serves homeowners and businesses seeking to reduce electricity costs and adopt renewable energy. Its residential clients include property owners in Las Cruces, El Paso, Colorado Springs, Springdale, and Philadelphia. Commercial projects are also undertaken, though specific industrial sectors are not detailed. The company works with customers regardless of whether they originally purchased their system from another provider, offering maintenance and system additions.

Founder Obed Dominguez states the company was started to make solar easy and accessible, with a mission to under-promise and over-deliver. Sunforce differentiates itself by sizing systems around actual usage history rather than generic estimates, confirming utility export credits, and providing transparent information about incentives, including the expiration of the federal residential solar tax credit at the end of 2025.

name: Sunlight Electric
old_description: Since 2002, we have performed residential and commercial electrical services of all kinds. Would you like to lower your electric bill at your home or business? Do you want new light fixtures, or to change some appliances out? We take our 20 years of experience, and guarantee quality service no matter the job!
about:
Sunlight Electric is based in Idaho Falls, Idaho, and traces its roots to 2002 when founder Robert Nichols began performing residential and commercial electrical work. After more than two decades as a union journeyman electrician, often traveling out of state for contract jobs, Nichols identified a local gap in green‑energy solutions such as solar installations, energy management systems, and EV charging. He launched the business under the Sunlight Electric name in August 2021 to stay closer to his family and serve the surrounding communities of Rexburg, Blackfoot, Pocatello, and Ashton.

The company provides a full range of electrical services for both homes and businesses, including electrical repair and troubleshooting, solar panel installation, lighting retrofits, backup generator installation and service, energy management systems, and electric‑vehicle charger installation. A team of over a dozen licensed electricians operates from a facility on East Piper Street, handling projects that range from single‑fixture changes to full facility LED conversions and solar arrays.

Customers include residential homeowners seeking lower utility bills and modern lighting, as well as commercial clients such as general contractors and facility managers who need to limit downtime and reduce production losses. Recent projects cited in reviews include a solar installation for a private residence, an LED retrofit for a commercial facility, and ongoing electrical service for a property management firm.

Nichols has said he started the company because he repeatedly heard from people who could not get an electrician to return their calls, and he enjoys tackling difficult troubleshooting jobs that others avoid. Sunlight Electric emphasizes transparent pricing — publishing its hourly rates online — timely communication, and a policy of not invoicing until the work meets its quality standard.

about:

The business built a local reputation for technical expertise and quality workmanship before expanding its reach nationally. Today the company is headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, and operates across 13 states.

The firm provides turnkey solar energy services for residential and commercial customers, including custom system design, engineering, panel installation, battery storage integration, microinverter deployment, and roofing coordination. It also offers engineering and installation support to other solar companies. To date, Suntria has completed more than 20,000 installations, backed by a 30-year warranty that covers 100 percent of parts, labor, removal, and reinstallation.

Primary customers are homeowners seeking energy independence, as well as solar developers and EPCs that subcontract engineering and installation work. The company has served "some of the most recognized names in solar" while maintaining a direct-to-consumer channel that helps households navigate federal tax credits, local incentives, and financing.

Suntria emphasizes a customer-centric mission to "win the happiness of our customers through energy independence." Differentiators cited by the company include U.S.-manufactured solar modules and equipment, financing programs with near-instant credit decisions, and a seamless process from design through warranty service, guided by values of integrity, innovation, and responsible growth.

about:
Superior Metal Fab LLC was founded in 2016 as a family-owned metal fabrication shop in Boring, Oregon. The company operates from a facility on SE Dee Street and serves customers across the Pacific Northwest, including Oregon, Idaho, and Washington. The business was established on decades of collective fabrication and welding experience, though the founders are not named publicly.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication and welding services from design through finish. Core capabilities include structural steel work (columns, beams, framing), stair fabrication, CNC plasma cutting via a PythonX system, and welding in TIG, MIG, and stick processes across materials such as stainless steel, galvanized steel, aluminum, titanium, 4130 chromoly, and mild steel. They also produce custom handrails, industrial ladders, platforms, catwalks, ornamental railings, gates, fences, and bollards, and offer aerospace welding services along with repair and maintenance.

Superior Metal Fab works with a mix of industrial, construction, aerospace, and residential clients. Local businesses in the Pacific Northwest commission structural and architectural metalwork, while aerospace welding requests come from specialized sectors. Testimonials reference projects ranging from residential handrails and porch railings to a custom van build and a support beam for a commercial remodel.

The company emphasizes its family-owned roots, decades of collective knowledge, and a commitment to delivering high-quality custom fabrication quickly and at competitive prices. It positions itself as a one-stop shop for any metal need, from ornamental pieces to aerospace-grade welds.
